## What landed

### d1 — OKC document-source live smoke (D-LIVE.1a-1 → DONE)

The live document parser in `okc_documents.py` — a configured live target carries a
REVIEWED clause map (`clauses` on the live-targets row, data not code):

- **HTML pages:** `html_text` → locate the `§ <section>` marker → verbatim slice to
  the next `§` marker.
- **PDFs:** `pdf_text_pages` → locate the bare `<N>-<M>` heading at line start
  (dot-leader TOC lines skipped) → verbatim slice to the next sibling heading —
  the OKCPD manual carries no `§` markers.
- **Per-fact grounding:** each fact's verbatim `literal` MUST appear in the slice
  (whitespace-folded); absent → recorded `ContentDrift`, never a claim beyond the
  capture. The literal becomes the claim's `raw_value`; the reviewed `value` is the
  typed interpretation. Locators are real: a `page` locator for PDFs, a
  `byte_range` into the extracted text for pages.
- The `live_clauses` doc kind routes through a dedicated extractor; every claim
  still passes `okc_claim` (predicate allowlist + Part VIII token guard +
  officer-naming gate + sensitivity/geo-tier stamping) — no path bypasses it.

**Live results** (`docs/build/reports/live_runs/2026-09-16_okc*.json`):

| source | outcome |
|---|---|
| `okcpd_policy` | fetched the real 469-page OKCPD Operations Manual PDF (robots-permitted), OCFL capture `bcnaay63…`, **3 clause claims into the hosted spine**: `use_restriction` ("official law enforcement purposes only"), `retention_period` ("at most 60 days unless required by law"), `sharing_restriction` ("shared only with other law enforcement agencies with System Administrator approval") — verbatim literals on pages 283–285. Re-run idempotent (19702→19702, content-digest dedupe). |
| `okc_procurement` | recorded `link_rotted` — okc.gov edge WAF 403s the purchasing index from this vantage |
| `ok_statute` | recorded `politeness_refusal` — OSCN robots.txt is `User-agent: * Disallow: /`; never bypassed |
